name: house-ai
description: Official House AI MCP server for AI interior and exterior design: redesign a room, a house exterior or a yard from a photo in 100+ styles, preview wall paint and flooring, empty or virtually stage a room, and find real furniture and decor to match.

HOUSE_AI_TOKEN.description: Personal House AI API token for the http-api-key installation (create one at https://www.houseaiapp.com/app/connector). Not needed for the recommended OAuth installation. Never commit your token. Designs use House AI credits.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Use an OAuth-capable MCP client and sign in with a House AI account. Style browsing works without signing in; designs use House AI credits.

http-api-key.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP with a personal House AI API token instead of OAuth. Designs use House AI credits.
